    • addComponent

      public void addComponent(ClientComponent component, int i, int j)
      Adds the given component to the player's list of components that compose the ship.
      (NOTE: the coordinates (i, j) are indexes, therefore, for example, adding a component in (row=5, col=7) actually places it at coordinates (4, 6))
      Parameters:
      component - The component that the player wants to place
      i - The row where the player wants to place the given component
      j - The column where the player wants to place the given component
